product: NASADEM Merged DEM Global 1 arc second
units_and_encoding: metres; int16; valid range -32767..32767; NUM layer = source/fill code per pixel (250 = interpolation, 251 = quad edge average, 170–220 = GDEM2)
license_or_use: EOSDIS Data Use and Citation Guidance: open sharing without restriction
notes: User guide: https://lpdaac.usgs.gov/documents/2237/NASADEM_User_Guide_V13.pdf. The full NUM code table is taken from the guide. North of 60°N is out of coverage.

role_in_pipeline: Cross-check (difference map with NASADEM); not primary
vertical_reference: Not stated on the product page
license_or_use: EOSDIS Data Use and Citation Guidance: open sharing without restriction
notes: The vertical datum is not stated on the product page; not critical for slope.

role_in_pipeline: Not used in the MVP. Could be used later only for known analogs north of 60°N (e.g. Devon Island)
spatial_coverage: 83°N–83°S (metadata N:82); gap-free except Greenland and Antarctica
units_and_encoding: metres; NUM layer = number of scenes
license_or_use: EOSDIS: open sharing without restriction; 'as is' disclaimer (NASA and METI/ERSDAC)
notes: The product page warns about anomalies and artefacts (may artificially raise roughness). Tiles overlap by 1 pixel at the edges. Not mixed with NASADEM.

product: MODIS/Aqua Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity 8-Day L3 Global 1km SIN Grid
role_in_pipeline: Primary Earth temperature: day−night LST difference (stand-in for the daily range) and stand-in for the yearly mean
units_and_encoding: Kelvin; LST_Day_1km and LST_Night_1km scale 0.02, valid 7500–65535; Day/Night_view_time hours, scale 0.1; QC_Day/QC_Night
license_or_use: EOSDIS data policy (open); no license text on the product page
notes: The overpass time is not assumed to be fixed; the per-pixel Day/Night_view_time is shown in the interface. The day−night difference is not a true daily min-max (two samples).

product: MODIS/Terra Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity 8-Day L3 Global 1km SIN Grid
units_and_encoding: Kelvin; scale 0.02; valid 7500–65535; view_time hours, scale 0.1
license_or_use: EOSDIS data policy (open); no license text on the product page

product: LOLA Gridded Data Record polar DEM 80–90°S 20 m
provider: NASA GSFC LOLA Team / PDS Geosciences Node
role_in_pipeline: Primary Moon reference DEM (windows around Shackleton)
units_and_encoding: kilometres; float32 (PC_REAL); HEIGHT = DN; radius = DN + 1737.4 km
license_or_use: PDS public archive; no license statement on the product page (NASA data)
notes: Not downloaded in full: windows read with HTTP Range using LBL offsets (around Shackleton ~60x60 km). Because of LOLA track spacing, a large share of pixels is interpolated.

product: South Pole LOLA DEM Mosaic 87–90°S 5 m/pix (Barker et al. 2021)
role_in_pipeline: Reliability check: aggregated 5 m→30 m slope compared with M1; ldec = number of observations (Evidence Coverage)
units_and_encoding: Z metres; slope degrees; ldec = LOLA returns per pixel (not an integer where they overlap)
vertical_reference: MOON_ME frame; reference radius not stated on the product page
temporal_coverage: No date range on the product page (Barker et al. 2021)
size: ldem 3,465,285,714 bayt; ldsm 4.9 GB; ldec 140 MB; hillshade 820 MB
license_or_use: No license statement on the page; citation: Barker et al. 2021
doi_or_citation: Barker et al. 2021, Planet. Space Sci. 203, 105119, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.pss.2020.105119
notes: Product typical RMS 30–55 cm; Barker 2021: median RMS Z ~0.30–0.50 m, slope ~1.5–2.5°. ~90% of the 5 m pixels are interpolated.

product: High-Resolution LOLA Topography for Lunar South Pole Sites
short_name: Site04 (Shackleton rim) / Site01 (Connecting ridge) / Site07 (Peak near Shackleton) / LM1 (Shackleton Rim B)
role_in_pipeline: Reference window positions (ROI shapefile) + region-level slope uncertainty (slperr)
spatial_coverage: Per site; coverage not on the page
units_and_encoding: Z metres; slope degrees; toterr metres RMS; slperr degrees RMS; 100 clones
license_or_use: No license statement on the page
doi_or_citation: Barker et al. 2021 (above); site numbering Mazarico et al. 2011
notes: Site names follow the numbering of Mazarico et al. 2011.

provider: UCLA (D. A. Paige) / PDS Geosciences Node
role_in_pipeline: Moon temperature: yearly mean (2 cm below the surface) and yearly maximum (surface) — Gap panel only
spatial_coverage: South pole; triangle mesh (planetocentric centre latitude/longitude)
resolution: NO grid spacing in the labels (data missing); 2,880,000 triangles
units_and_encoding: temp_avg K (yearly mean calculated 2 cm below the surface); temp_max K (yearly maximum at the surface); ice_depth m (>2.8738 m = -999)
license_or_use: PDS public archive; no license statement
notes: Derived from a thermal model fit (Derived Parameter), not a direct measurement. temp_avg is 2 cm below the surface, not at the surface.

product: Diviner Polar Cumulative Product — diurnal local-time bins (south)
provider: UCLA Diviner Team (Williams; Sullivan) / PDS Geosciences Node
role_in_pipeline: Moon daily temperature range (max−min of summer-season local-time bins) — P2 (optional)
spatial_coverage: 10° latitude polar cap (80–90°S); south polar stereographic grid
units_and_encoding: Bolometric brightness temperature (K), local-time bin average; 96 local-time bins x summer/winter
size: ~89–244 MB per file; the summer set alone ~18 GB (estimate from the directory listing)
license_or_use: PDS public archive; no license statement
doi_or_citation: Williams, J-P.; Sullivan, M. (2022) Diviner PCP collection; UCLA duyurusu https://www.diviner.ucla.edu/single-post/new-diviner-south-polar-data-products-released-on-pds
verification_status: PARTIAL (directory and naming verified; bin width and columns to be read from the LBL)
notes: Read as a stream without writing to disk, keeping only the Shackleton box. A slon (subsolar longitude) set of similar size also exists.

product: MOLA Mission Experiment Gridded Data Record 128 ppd topography
provider: NASA GSFC MOLA Team / PDS Geosciences Node
role_in_pipeline: Mars context and scale sensitivity (463 m); not primary
vertical_reference: Areoid: GMM3 (mgm1025) degree/order 50; A axis 3396.0 km
temporal_coverage: MGS MOLA 1997–2001 (to be checked in the label)
license_or_use: PDS public archive; no license statement
notes: Cannot be used on the common 30 m grid; only in the 463 m sensitivity test.

product: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation CTX DTM Mosaic
provider: USGS Astrogeology Science Center (for NASA Mars 2020)
role_in_pipeline: Primary Mars reference DEM (Jezero landing area)

product: Mars 2020 Science Investigation CTX DEM Mosaic (covers all of Jezero crater)
role_in_pipeline: Backup: if R2 coverage is not enough for 10 km windows

verification_status: PARTIAL (no unit → cannot be used quantitatively)
notes: Relative brightness mosaic; cannot be compared with Earth/Moon temperature. Mars temperature = 'Data missing'.

product: THEMIS Thermal Inertia Mosaic Quantitative 100 mpp
role_in_pipeline: First on the cut list (Mars temperature); only if time allows
notes: Not used until verified. There is no equivalent NASA thermal inertia product for Earth in the inventory.
Shown in the interface as 'out of scope / no data'.

version: Mapzen/Tilezen tile set (no version number published)
provider: AWS Open Data Registry (Mapzen/Tilezen); mostly NASA SRTM, plus other sources in places
role_in_pipeline: On-demand landform check of any clicked point in the browser (approximate; not the NASADEM pipeline; never mixed into the shipped candidate ranking)
spatial_coverage: Global, Web Mercator to 85°N/S; NASA SRTM only 60°N–56°S, other (non-NASA) sources outside and in some countries
resolution: zoom 12–14 used (pixel ~15–19 m on the ground; underlying source mostly SRTM 1 arc-second ~30 m), averaged to a 30 m local grid
units_and_encoding: metres = (R*256 + G + B/256) - 32768; heights <= 0 m treated as sea (no land data)
size: ~50–150 KB per tile; 9–16 tiles per point
license_or_use: AWS Open Data terms; attribution to the sources (incl. NASA SRTM, USGS, ETOPO1/GMTED etc.) required
verification_status: VERIFIED (CORS and decode tested in browser)
notes: Approximate. Validation vs shipped NASADEM windows in docs/GLOBAL_ANALYSIS.md. Source mix per place not shown by the tiles.
